title: When the Provision Sings
author: Q. M. Dunmore
blurb: Oscar Lockridge, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
